# Lakeside Meter Disputes

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Disputes

A disputed meter reading must be reported within 30 days of the bill with Form UT-310.

## 2 Meter test

A meter test costs 25 euros. The fee is refunded if the meter is found to be faulty.
